name: FORM — OMNI machine
convention: key 0 = AUX; keys 1-10 = black keys (top row); keys 11-26 = white keys (16-step row, key 11 = step 0). '#000000' = off. These states show the OMNI step sequencer machine's own UI modes. In CONFIG/MIX (state 1) OMNI shares the grid with the container (top row = machine select). When a step is held, or in the note/transpose editors (states 2-4), OMNI consumes ALL keys and the top row becomes an overlay.
notes: OMNI is the one fully-built FORM machine: a polyphonic step sequencer (up to 6 notes/step, velocity, gate, nudge, probability, conditional trigs, step functions, transpose pattern, per-step MIDI-FX). Its UI has modes CONFIG/MIX (SEQ view), LENGTH (near-noop), TRANSPOSE, STEP/NOTEEDIT — chosen with Pot 5 or AUX+keys 13-18. Step-row legend (SEQ view): LTBLUE #a8a8ff = step has notes, DKBLUE #00004d = in-length but empty, off = muted or beyond track length, WHITE = playhead on a firing step, RED = playhead on a silent step, LTYELLOW #ffff80 = a held step's jump-to target.

states.name: OMNI — SEQ view (CONFIG/MIX)
states.notes: Default OMNI page, playing. Top row = container machine-select (key3=selected OMNI WHITE, key4=OMNI ORANGE, key5=EUCL CYAN, rest empty). Bottom 16 = the step pattern: LTBLUE steps have notes, DKBLUE steps are empty, and the WHITE playhead is on step 4 (key15). Tap a step = mute/unmute; double-tap = jump to note editor; hold a step = arm the function overlay (state 2).

states.name: OMNI — step held (function overlay)
states.notes: While a step key is HELD, OMNI takes over the whole grid. Top keys 1-7 become the step-FUNCTION palette: RED=-- , ORANGE=RSET, DKYELLOW=<< , GREEN=>> , MAGENTA=<> , ROSE=J? , DIMORANGE=???. The step's current function key blinks (shown here on GREEN=>>, key4). The step row keeps the pattern; a step shown LTYELLOW (#ffff80, key20) is the 'jump to step N' target when the held step's function is a jump. Press a palette key to set the function, or another step key to set 'jump to that step'.

keyNotes.20: Jump-to-step target (LTYELLOW) for the held step

encoder.note: Turn = select param; AUX+turn = edit the held step's params

states.name: OMNI — note editor (NOTEEDIT)
states.notes: Chord/note entry for the selected step. OMNI consumes all keys and lays out a piano/scale keyboard (example = C major). Scale roots = light periwinkle #a2a2ff (key12 C4, key19 C5, key26 C6); in-scale notes = dim blue #000090; out-of-scale (all black keys here) = off. Notes stored on the selected step are lit LTYELLOW #ffff80 (in view) — here a C-E-G chord on keys 12/14/16. Key 11 is forced DKRED as the REST / clear-step key. The selected-step cursor pulses HALFWHITE #808080 (here key15). If the step is muted the keyboard tints red (roots RED, in-scale DKRED) instead.

keyNotes.11: REST — clears the selected step to empty (forced DKRED)
keyNotes.12: Chord note C (LTYELLOW), also a scale root

states.name: OMNI — transpose pattern editor
states.notes: Per-step transpose lane. Step row shows the transpose pattern within the pattern length (here len=9, keys 11-19; keys 20-26 beyond length = off): TZERO #0000ff = 0 (no transpose), THIGH #8080ff = transpose up, TLOW #000020 = transpose down. Top-key shortcuts: key1=F1 #80ffff, key2=F2 #00ff80, key3 random-arm #80ffff, key9 full-randomize ORANGE, key10 clear RED. Holding a step turns keys 1-10 into a value bar (bright grey #d0d0d0 filled up to the value).

keyNotes.3: Hold = random-arm, then tap a step to randomize it

encoder.note: Turn = select step/param; AUX+turn = edit transpose value
